newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas untraded but well bid and offered.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas untraded but well bid and offered.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were untraded on Monday morning but bids and offers were posted in all periods at the close of the morning session.

Bids and offers straddled previous settlement prices in nearly all periods by the close, indicating a lack of specific price direction. The only exception to this was January, where the offer, at 18.35 pence a therm, was at parity with the settlement level on Friday.
Front month August was bid at 9.425 pence by the close and offered at 9.55 pence.
